u0: Initial state: the ball still blocks access to the locked door, the door is closed, and no successful blocker progress has been recorded. Next objective: move the blocking ball away from the cell in front of the door while avoiding losing the matching key before the door is open. If blocker_moved becomes true without key_lost, progress to u1; a key_lost event here sends the agent into the failed branch u5.
u1: The blocker milestone has been achieved at least once and no key_lost event has occurred. The matching door key is not yet held in the typical path, and the door remains closed. Next objective: acquire and hold the matching key while ensuring the cell in front of the door is still clear; when blocker_moved and has_door_key both hold without key_lost, progress to u2. Dropping the matching key while the door is closed triggers key_lost and moves to the failed branch u5.
u2: The blocker has been moved and the agent currently carries the key matching the locked door, but the door is still closed. Next objective: open the door by toggling it while keeping the blocker clear, reaching door_open without key_lost to progress to u3. Do not drop the matching key while the door remains closed, because that fires key_lost and diverts to the failed branch u5.
u3: The locked door has been opened successfully and no disqualifying key_lost event has occurred. The mission's target box is still in the other room and not yet carried. Next objective: enter the box room and pick up the mission-named target box; if the key is occupying the agent's hands, drop it while the door remains open so that key_lost does not fire. Picking up the target box without key_lost reaches final success u4; a key_loss violation here leads to the failure sink u6.
u4: Final success state: the agent is carrying the mission's designated target box, and target_picked_up occurred without a key_loss violation. The episode ends on this pickup, the task is complete, and there is no further objective; this is the absorbing successful terminal state.
u5: Failure branch after key loss: the matching key was acquired and then dropped or lost while the door was still closed, so key_lost has occurred. There is no path back to the successful final state from here. The only possible RM transition is to remain in u5 if the door stays closed, or to incur a -1 penalty and enter the violation sink u6 if the door is opened; therefore, avoid opening the door in this compromised branch.
u6: Failure sink: the reward machine's prohibited key-loss condition has been violated, either by opening the door after the matching key was lost while it was closed or by another key_lost event after door progress, and a -1 penalty has been incurred. No further successful progress is possible; all transitions remain in u6, so this is an absorbing task-failure state even though the underlying environment may continue until its own episode cutoff.
